response.sql:
WITH artifact_rows AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
), total AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total
  FROM artifact_rows
), shares AS (
  SELECT a.zoneref, a.articount,
         CAST(a.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share
  FROM artifact_rows AS a
  CROSS JOIN total AS t
), scored AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT zoneref, articount, share, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each non-NULL scanfeatures row is one count whose share is computed against the sum of all non-NULL articount values; the average share is the unweighted mean across those rows. A zero total yields NULL shares and differences.
